subject: [PATCH 38/60] mm/page_alloc: refuse contiguous allocation from private memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a check to reject contiguous allocation from private memory nodes with -EPERM and documents the error. It also suggests growing an ACR flag or exporting an API for private allocations.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memory management in the Linux kernel by refusing contiguous allocation from private memory nodes. The goal is to prevent potential issues that can arise when allocating large ranges of memory on private nodes, which bypass zonelists and can trigger compaction and reclaim.
